## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes and why. Mention security or compatibility implications.

## Validation

List the checks actually executed and their results. Identify skipped checks and outstanding manual work.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Documentation describes the final implementation in English.
- [ ] Required source files, tests, and reusable agent artifacts are included.
- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic data only; no credentials, private paths, or personal agent configuration are included.
- [ ] Process lifecycle changes have appropriate synthetic integration coverage, or the remaining validation is explicitly stated.
